pcs.pc_description: Understand the usage pattern of the mixer/grinder from the customer and perform an initial inspection to identify potential faults.
Unplug the unit and reset the overload switch to its original position in case of power supply overload.
Conduct basic tests such as power supply inspection, volt-ampere testing, and earthing checks to identify electrical issues.
Inspect all internal modules of the unit. If the fault remains unidentified, escalate the issue by sending the unit to the manufacturer's service center.
Replace faulty components on-site, provided the required parts are available.
Schedule a follow-up visit if the faulty module is unavailable at the site. Return with the repaired or replaced module to complete the service.

Complete all documentation procedures, including recording complaint closure and collecting payments from the customer as per company guidelines.

pcs.pc_description: Connect the non-functional LED light to an AC power source, switch it on, and inspect for any loose or de-soldered wires and faulty connections if the light does not illuminate.

Repair or replace damaged components/SMPs (Switch Mode Power Supplies) and verify the output voltage and current of the supply unit using a multimeter.
Inspect the non-functional or damaged LED strips, and replace burnt-out or faulty LED strips with new ones.
Check the LED array by connecting it to an AC power source and switching it on to confirm its functionality.
Reassemble the LED light, ensuring all repaired and replaced components are securely fitted, and test the overall performance of the unit.
Place the LED light back into its fixture and evaluate its performance in a real-use scenario.

modules.module_title: Diagnosing Faults in Geysers or Fans

pcs.pc_description: Conduct basic diagnostic tests to identify issues in the power supply, external faults, improper mounting, or other visible problems in the faulty fan or geyser.
Use a multimeter to inspect the mains outlet and electrical/electronic components for correct voltage output and proper connectivity.
Disassemble the fan or geyser to access internal components and perform functional tests to isolate the defective parts.
Identify and fix minor external faults such as loose connections, improper mounting, or external component alignment.
Replace the defective components or modules, and reassemble the fan or geyser following proper procedures.
Train or assist colleagues/assistants in handling repair processes, ensuring collaboration and skill-sharing.
Inform the supervisor and adhere to company policies if replacement components are unavailable or require special procurement.
Test the repaired fan/geyser's functionality against the service manual's specifications to ensure full operation.
Demonstrate the repaired unit's functionality to the customer and confirm their satisfaction.
Clean the repair area, ensure proper disposal of debris, and obtain the customer's permission for any leftover materials.
Complete documentation procedures to record complaint closure, collect applicable charges, and update customer records.
Collect the defective components and hand them over to the stores as per the company’s process for replacement or disposal.

pcs.pc_description: Analyze the customer location and plan an efficient route to visit the site as per the job card/work sheet.
Interact with the customer upon arrival, greet them professionally, and confirm whether the water purifier will be placed under the sink (UTS) or mounted on the wall.
Assess if the location meets structural requirements, such as proximity to the power supply, plumbing points, and space availability.
Inform the customer about any pre- installation work required at their premises.
Educate the customer about the need for adequate water pressure at the inlet source for proper operation.
Make accurate markings for the placement of the water purifier unit based on customer preference and structural suitability.
Evaluate all requirements and proceed with installation if satisfied. If not, communicate the issues to the customer and reschedule the installation.
Unbox the purifier in front of the customer, explaining each step to maintain transparency.
Verify that the product matches the customer’s order, ensuring all supporting accessories and tools for installation are available.
Clear and properly dispose of the packaging materials in compliance with the company’s environmental norms.

modules.module_title: Install and Check the Functionality of the Water Purifier

pcs.pc_description: Measure and mark the identified location before drilling holes, ensuring no internal wiring damage occurs.
Mount and securely fasten the purifier unit and its filter components.
Drain the inlet line before connecting it to the purifier and attach the outlet pipe to the drain, if applicable.
Ensure that the purifier is aligned correctly according to the installation manual.
Test the purifier to confirm there are no leaks and that all connections are secure.
Demonstrate the purifier’s features and utility to the customer, explaining its advantages.
Educate the customer on the maintenance procedures and usage guidelines to extend the purifier’s life.

modules.module_title: Diagnose Faults and Fix Dysfunctional Components

pcs.pc_description: Diagnose faults based on customer-reported issues and observations.
Confirm whether the water pressure meets the specified company standards for the purifier’s operation.
Shut off the water supply and unplug the unit to safely inspect the purifier for potential issues.
Follow all safety precautions during repairs, such as using cloths or towels to avoid spills and maintain cleanliness.
Perform a basic inspection of components like the feed water valve, tank valve, tubing, and housing for potential faults.
Replace or repair the faulty component on- site, if feasible, or seek the customer’s permission to transport the unit to the service center for further repairs.
After repairs, reassemble the unit and test it to ensure proper functionality. Confirm customer satisfaction and complete the job.
